llm.summary: This is a read-only QA domain-modeling skill that tells an agent how to analyze requirements into state, data-flow, and service-dependency models.

dimensions.detail: The declared tools are Read, Grep, and Glob, which are proportionate for inspecting requirements or scenario-tree inputs and do not grant mutation, shell, network, or credential access.

dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation terms such as “建模” and “数据流” are somewhat broad, but the skill content remains bounded to modeling and test-analysis guidance, with no hidden or unrelated behavior.

llm.guidance: Install this skill when you want agents to analyze complex requirements into domain models for testing. Be aware it may activate on broad modeling-related wording, so use explicit prompts or disable it in contexts where general modeling language should not trigger QA domain-modeling behavior.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The scanner concern about broad activation is supported by the trigger text, but the behavior is read-only and purpose-aligned, so it is best treated as a usability/scoping note rather than a security review concern.
